#### ✨ Features
- **Backspace Repeat Haptic Feedback**: Delivers continuous tactile pulses on each repeated character deletion when holding down the backspace key (with empty text suppression and settings toggle).
- **Enter Key Tasker Event**: Dispatches a high-priority Android Intent broadcast (`dev.custom.gboard.ENTER_PRESSED`) to Tasker whenever the Enter or IME action key is pressed, including active package, action type, and cursor text.
- **Glide Trail Customization**: Samsung Keyboard / Good Lock (Keys Cafe) style glide typing trail customization (fade speed, dynamic Rainbow RGB, color presets, stroke thickness, and tail length decay).
- **Morphe Independent Selection**: All patches can be individually enabled or combined together in Morphe Manager.

#### 📱 Add to Morphe App
1. Open the **Morphe** app on your Android device.
2. Navigate to **Settings** -> **Sources**.
3. Tap **Add Source** and paste:

### 🚀 Updated App Support

* **nuviotv:** support 1.1.0-beta.5 across all patches [skip ci] ([dd7a8f4](https://github.com/Santodan/santodan-patches/commit/dd7a8f4b08fa71cf9b167e7c67f9e27dfa4bea41))


## Detailed changes

## NuvioTV features

- Add **Upcoming movie dates in library and collections** for beta.4 and beta.5.
  Two independent, disabled-by-default switches under **UI** show blue `dd-MMM-yy`
  badges on unreleased movie posters. Exact poster metadata takes precedence;
  missing dates use a bounded background catalog lookup with a six-hour cache.
  Released movies and unknown dates have no badge. A past release year skips
  unnecessary lookups; current/future years still require an exact date.
- Add **Preload streams in Continue Watching** for playable movie/episode cards.
- Add **Preload streams on detail page** for the current Play or Resume target,
  following changes to the next episode. Both **Streams** switches are independent
  and disabled by default. They reuse Nuvio's native source search, installed
  addons/plugins, cache expiration, profile checks, and playback pause controls.
  Background work is bounded, and playback starts only when Play is pressed.
- Group the Santodan-Patches menu under **Continue Watching**, **UI**, and **Streams**
  using native, non-focusable labels. Groups with no installed patches are omitted.

## Compatibility and improvements

- Support NuvioTV **1.1.0-beta.5** across all existing patches. Movie dates, finale
  dates, airing series, and stream preloading support beta.4/beta.5. Merged progress,
  remaining episodes, and side-by-side installation also support beta.2.
- Reduce remaining-episode badge work by counting recently displayed cards in the
  background, limiting catalog fallback work, and stopping new work when disabled.
- Isolate badge Compose groups to preserve the host's remembered state. Movie and
  series date badges can be selected independently or together.
- Add stream diagnostics for preload starts, elapsed time, source counts, and
  timeout/cancellation outcomes. Repeated composition hits stay silent; stream
  URLs are omitted and custom video IDs are redacted.
- Movie-date toggle diagnostics identify **library** or **collections**. Routine
  settings-render logs are suppressed.

## Diagnostics and validation

- Add `"SantodanStreams:V"` and `"SantodanMovieRelease:V"` to logcat filters.
- Movie dates use native release-time rules: date-only releases use UTC midnight,
  zoned timestamps use their exact instant, and timestamp badges show the local date.
  Release metadata does not guarantee an available streaming source.
- Local checks cover date parsing, release boundaries, timezone handling,
  independent settings, nested/restart card scopes, and all 128 menu selections.
  Original beta.4/beta.5 DEX checks verify coexistence with the existing patches.
  Real beta.5 APK application and final DEX verification cover the movie patch on
  its own and with all Nuvio patches. Device logs confirm working date lookups and
  successful stream preloads without badge-rendering errors.

Hushfeed 0.50.0 keeps failed settings writes recoverable, keeps movable feed controls inside safe areas, and moves Feature Gate Lab ranking off TikTok's UI thread.

### What changed

* Large translated settings titles now keep words whole at enlarged text sizes.
* Movable feed controls stay clear of system bars, display cutouts and TikTok's bottom tab row.
* Feature Gate Lab precomputes searchable text and ranks nonempty searches on a cancellable worker.
* Failed settings writes restore the live value and preserve an unfinished migration source.
* Failed local feed actions now report the error instead of showing a false success or Undo action.
* Concurrent setting writes are serialized so an older failed write can't roll back a newer value.
* Settings restore rejects fractional and overflowing backup schema numbers.
* Session budget resets invalidate older queued writes.
* The guarded S22 tool now reads the focused app on display 0, targets input to display 0, recognizes wrapped Android 16 activity records and resolves Windows ADB paths under WSL.

### Compatibility and verification

This release targets the global TikTok 47.0.3 APK, version code 2024700030. All 91 patches apply without forcing compatibility or changing the manifest on 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3, 46.9.3 and 47.0.3.

The local gate passed 1,471 TikTok runtime tests, 243 patch tests and both Android lints. The exact bundle produced a 91-patch APK that was installed over the existing same-signer TikTok build on the S22 without clearing app data. The installed APK matched the candidate byte for byte, the original first-install time stayed intact, and the account stayed signed in. Hushfeed remains the first Settings and privacy row and reports version 0.50.0 for TikTok 47.0.3.

A second Samsung pass used an S25 Ultra running TikTok 47.0.3 with its existing Hushfeed 0.46.0 build. In dark theme, Hushfeed was first in Settings and privacy. The settings root, search, Back behavior and Feature Gate Lab worked. Its older hook report found 60 of 63 checked anchors, with two comments-sheet anchors and one story-viewer anchor missing. This is a useful older-build baseline, not exact 0.50.0 acceptance. The S25 installation uses a different Morphe Manager signing key, so the 0.50.0 test APK wasn't installed and no app data was removed.

Bundle SHA-256: `c98422ce65cc604263a13b311180c43e16e6b27af2519646f3c7da1da835d964`

### Open checks

Feature Gate Lab search is off the main thread, but the strict frame trace still recorded 8 of 15 app frames above 16.67 ms. Portrait feed-control safe areas passed. TikTok kept the tested feed activity in portrait when landscape was requested, so landscape coverage remains open.

Issue #16 was reported against Hushfeed 0.48.0 on a Galaxy A73. The exact 0.50.0 S22 candidate showed the seek bar, opened comments without sending, loaded Watch history and opened a history item. The reporter's device and account condition remain under investigation.

## What changed

Playback quality now reaches the player. The setting picked a gear out of the video model's own list and the diagnostic report said so, but TikTok's player builds its models from a different list that the patch left alone, so every video still played at whatever quality the player chose. That is what issue #3 saw on a Galaxy A56. The choice is now made at the one door into the player's list, on all four retained builds, and the report names it: a line like "picked lowest_540_1 540p of 5 gears from SimVideoUrlModel#setBitRate" is the player's list. The hook status row also stops counting a non-adaptive video's empty model as a missing hook, which is what turned "2 missing" into a false alarm.

Every patch applies on TikTok 46.9.3, the build after the three the bundle is checked against. Fourteen patches used to fail there for one reason: 46.9.3's build of TikTok marks methods final and stops merging small lambdas into shared classes, so targets that had not moved stopped matching. Feed filter, Hide already seen videos, Hide CAPTCHA popups, Hide the risk control CAPTCHA, Comment sort controls, Comment tools, Advanced downloads, Subtitle tools, Share sheet tools, Translate comments and Disable the long press quick share now find their targets by what the code does rather than by how the compiler shaped it, and the three resource optimizers carry a reviewed profile for the new build. The declared target stays 46.2.3.

Smaller changes. The feature gate recorder's report dialog puts Save JSON last with the accent, Copy report no longer closes it, a stop with nothing read says so in a sentence, a fresh install's row no longer reports a recording of zero gates, and once a report exists the row offers Start recording or Show last report. Saved gate reports are named by date under Download/Hushfeed, and a refused background pool says the export could not start. A session hold stops its once-a-second timer while TikTok is in the background. Settings rows keep their drawables when the list rebinds the same view. A settings backup without a schema number reads as the first schema, and one newer than this build reads is refused with the schema reason.

## Validation

1,372 runtime tests and 215 patch tests passed locally with no failures, errors or skips, and both Android API level checks passed. The bundle carries 81 patches with all three DEX payloads non-empty, and every patch applied with zero failures to the 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3 and 46.9.3 fixtures; the receipt beside this release records each verdict. Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer.

On a Galaxy S22 with this build, the playback quality setting on lowest picked the 540p gear and on highest the 1080p gear out of the same lists at the player's own setter, with the hook status row reading 4 found, 0 missing.

## BannerHub v6 1.8.0-604 > ## ⚠️ Important — please read before installing > > **BannerHub v6 does NOT replace BannerHub 3.7.x or BannerHub Lite — they are SEPARATE projects.** > > - **BannerHub** 3.7.x — built from the GameHub 5.3.5 ReVanced project by **PlayDay**. > - **BannerHub Lite** — built from GameHub Lite 5.1.4 by **Producdevity**. > - **BannerHub v6** *(this repo)* — built from XiaoJi GameHub 6.0.x on a brand-new pipeline. > > **None of the three are to be updated over by any of the others.** Each ships with its own package names, its own keystore, and its own component / Steam-client backend — Android won't accept an in-place update between them, and forcing one will leave you with a broken install. Uninstall first, then install the new project if you want to switch. > > Keep in mind **BannerHub v6 is still a work in progress** and will re-release frequently as new base GameHub versions come out from XiaoJi upstream. **Compatibility is different** — don't expect every game that works on BannerHub 3.7.x or Lite to work on v6, and vice versa. v6 uses a **new component system and new Steam clients** and, thus far, has been **barely tested in general**. > > **USE AT YOUR OWN RISK.** A patched build of **XiaoJi GameHub 6.0.4** that removes the login requirement (import and play games with no account) and redirects the catalog to the BannerHub Cloudflare Worker. Ships **9 variants that install side-by-side**, each with an optional **Lite** build (~34.5 MB / ≈32% smaller). **18 APKs attached** — 9 full + 9 Lite. Steam game launches work end-to-end. 🔒 **Privacy-hardened** — upstream telemetry/analytics channels stripped at the bytecode level. Full list of killed channels (and the honest leftovers) in [`PRIVACY.md`](https://github.com/The412Banner/bannerhub-revanced/blob/gamehub-604-build/PRIVACY.md).
✨ Everything BannerHub v6 offers (click to expand) - **No login required** — launch straight to the home screen and import/play games without a XiaoJi account. - **Custom catalog API** — the catalog is redirected to the BannerHub Cloudflare Worker for **curated component delivery** (hand-picked DXVK, VKD3D-Proton, Box64, FEX, Mesa Turnip driver builds, etc.) instead of the stock upstream set. - **Privacy-hardened** — upstream telemetry/analytics channels stripped at the bytecode level (see the `PRIVACY.md` link above for the full list). - **PC-accurate controller vibration** — real XInput rumble routed into Android's VibratorManager with independent dual-motor support, configurable **per-game** (mode + intensity) via the **PC Vibration Settings** menu row. Preload-free — no `libevshim` / `LD_PRELOAD`. - **GOG integration** — sign in to GOG, browse your owned library, and download + install GOG games in-app; they're added to your GameHub library and launch like any other PC game. Reached from the Explore tab's GOG card or the Banner Tools → GOG tile. - **BannerHub Explore homepage** — the bottom-nav "Explore" tab opens a BannerHub-owned homepage instead of the stock online discovery feed: wordmark/logo hero, a "What's New" article that auto-syncs from the release notes, the GOG store card, and an in-app **update banner + installed-vs-latest version readout** with a settings cog. Content can refresh live via an external JSON override; still fully offline-capable. - **Recording-compatible audio** — optional toggle (Banner Tools → Audio) that routes PulseAudio through the mixer so screen recorders capture in-game sound. - **In-game performance overlay** *(root)* — a draggable edge pill → slide-out panel for live CPU-governor + Adreno min-clock toggles while gaming; off by default, root-gated, auto-reverts on exit. Toggle from Banner Tools → In-game Overlay. - **9 side-by-side variants** — different package names + launcher labels so multiple builds coexist on one device (`Original` replaces stock GameHub; the rest install alongside it). - **Optional Lite builds** — a ~34.5 MB-smaller counterpart of every variant. - **Muted UI sounds** — menu/button click sounds silenced; in-game audio untouched. - **Root-free file manager access** — a content provider lets MT Manager and similar apps browse GameHub's data dir without root. - **Portrait PC-settings** — per-game PC settings render in both landscape and portrait (side benefit of the API redirect). - **Installs in place** — stable signing keystore; future BannerHub v6 stables upgrade without uninstalling. - **BannerHub v6 branding** — custom app icon, Wine container header, and auth/splash artwork. - **Triage-friendly** — debuggable build with logcat markers along the import path.
### What's new in 1.8.0-604 On top of `v1.7.0-604` (same keystore — installs in place): ### ⚡ In-game performance overlay (root) A new in-game overlay for on-the-fly performance tuning without leaving your game. A draggable edge **pill** slides out a panel with root-gated toggles: - **CPU governor → performance** — pins the CPU governor while you play. - **Adreno GPU min-clock boost** — raises the kgsl minimum frequency so the GPU stops downclocking under load. The overlay is **off by default** and the whole feature is **root-gated** — non-rooted devices (and anyone who doesn't enable it) see nothing. Turn it on from **Banner Tools → In-game Overlay**, with a separate **Root** tile to grant/verify su. Includes a **pill opacity slider** so you can make it as subtle as you like, and it **auto-reverts** the CPU/GPU changes when you exit the game. ### 🛠️ Banner Tools now in the Explorer screen The **Banner Tools** option now lives in the **Explorer** tab/screen. Its settings are **per-game options only** — you open Banner Tools from a game in the Explorer view and the changes you make apply to that game alone, not app-wide. ### Variants Each variant has its own package name + launcher label, so the variants install **side-by-side** with each other. `Original` replaces an installed GameHub; the rest install alongside it. **Full vs Lite:** a Lite APK shares its full counterpart's package name and cert — installing Lite **replaces** the matching full build (and vice versa). They do **not** coexist; pick one per row. | Variant | Package | Full APK / Lite APK | | --- | --- | --- | | Normal | `banner.hub` | `…-Normal.apk` / `…-Normal-Lite.apk` | | Normal-GHL | `gamehub.lite` | `…-Normal-GHL.apk` / `…-Normal-GHL-Lite.apk` | | PuBG | `com.tencent.ig` | `…-PuBG.apk` / `…-PuBG-Lite.apk` | | AnTuTu | `com.antutu.ABenchMark` | `…-AnTuTu.apk` / `…-AnTuTu-Lite.apk` | | alt-AnTuTu | `com.antutu.benchmark.full` | `…-alt-AnTuTu.apk` / `…-alt-AnTuTu-Lite.apk` | | PuBG-CrossFire | `com.tencent.tmgp.cf` | `…-PuBG-CrossFire.apk` / `…-PuBG-CrossFire-Lite.apk` | | Ludashi | `com.ludashi.aibench` | `…-Ludashi.apk` / `…-Ludashi-Lite.apk` | | Genshin | `com.miHoYo.GenshinImpact` | `…-Genshin.apk` / `…-Genshin-Lite.apk` | | Original | `com.xiaoji.egggame` | `…-Original.apk` / `…-Original-Lite.apk` | Filenames follow `BannerHub-V6-1.8.0-604-Patched-{variant}[-Lite].apk`. ## Why was the MyoAdapt patch removed?

MyoAdapt's core feature, its adaptive training engine, which plans your next workout based on your completed sessions, runs entirely on MyoAdapt's servers and is fed only by server-side workout history. For accounts without an active subscription, the server hard-blocks (HTTP 402) every action that records or updates a workout.

A client-side patch can fake the workout flow (start, log, finish a session), but the server never learns about any of it: no history, no stats, and the proposed next workout never changes. The patch could therefore never deliver the one thing MyoAdapt is actually worth using for. So rather than shipping something that promises premium but can't deliver it, it has been removed.

---

Every arm64 build of Messenger 580.0.0.49.91 works now, and there are four new switches. 31 patches in all.

**New**

- **View stories anonymously** opens other people's stories without putting you on their viewer list (#7). Stories you open this way still show as seen on the People tab and in the story viewer, also after a restart. One spot doesn't follow along yet: the ring around that person's picture in your chat list keeps showing the story as new until it expires.
- **Save any story** adds **Save** to the **More options** menu on other people's stories (#4). Photos and videos download the way your own stories do, and a saved video lands in Movies/Messenger.
- **Send photos at original quality.** Even with HD on, Messenger re-encodes a photo before sending it, so a 6.4 MB photo went out as about 1.8 MB. With this switch an HD JPEG goes out with its own image data. Its metadata, like location and camera details, stays behind just as it does with Messenger's copy. Photos over 20 MB and videos still get Messenger's compression.
- **Material You theme** brings your wallpaper's colors into Messenger's dark mode on Android 12 and newer (#16). Turn on dark mode in Messenger first, then use **Restart Messenger**.
- All 21 arm64 builds APKMirror has for 580.0.0.49.91 are supported, including the 14 made for a single screen density, so "version code ... is not supported" shouldn't come up for any of them.
- When a switch's code fails inside Messenger, its line now says **Stopped with an error**, and **Copy setup** lists the failure without the error's text.
- The settings screen can be translated. None ship yet. The README says how to add a language.

**Changed and fixed**

- **Hide Meta AI** removes the Meta AI tab some accounts get in the bottom bar (#13). It changes after **Restart Messenger**.
- **Hide People You May Know** now covers the People tab and search too, and the story viewer no longer slips in a page of suggested people.
- **Hide growth prompts** also hides the notes tip sheets, like **Make my notes public**, and the **Share your own story** card at the end of someone else's stories.
- Settings open on Morphe Manager's Root Mount installs (#12). There's no drawer icon on a mount install, so use the long-press shortcut or the HushMessenger row in the Menu tab.
- **Hide Facebook shortcuts** now says that it removes the "Also from Meta" section in the Menu tab (#14). It already did.
- The update check compares version numbers as numbers, so a future 0.10.0 won't look older than 0.9.0.
- `check_install.py` finds Messenger data left behind by an uninstall that kept the data, which caused "INSTALL_FAILED_VERSION_DOWNGRADE ... 2147483647" in #9.
- The build moved to Kotlin Gradle plugin 2.4.20 (CVE-2026-53914) and Bouncy Castle 1.86.

**Updating**

Refresh the HushMessenger source in Morphe, patch Messenger again with the same key and install it over your current copy. Then use **Restart Messenger**. New switches start off.

**Checking the download**

This is the first release with `SHA256SUMS.txt.sig`, an SSH signature over the checksum file, made with the release key whose fingerprint is `SHA256:Z+UfHy7IUbtgNRO/wHkIr68+u4I+SIKPY9avfx/VAPU`. Morphe Manager and Desktop don't check it, so the README shows how to do it yourself with `ssh-keygen` and `scripts/release_signers`.

Before release, Morphe Desktop 1.18.0 applied all 31 patches to five of the builds, one from each group that shares the same internal names, and every patched APK passed Android's signature check. Two clean builds of the bundle, one of them from a fresh checkout, came out byte for byte the same.

The full list is in the [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/blob/v0.7.0/CHANGELOG.md).

HushGram v0.0.7 has 78 patches for Instagram 450.0.0.50.77, 3 more than v0.0.6. It still targets the arm64-v8a build 385611438, and now the other arm64 builds of that version patch too, along with the x86 and x86_64 ones. It needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer and runs on Android 9 and newer. Here's everything that changed.

## What's new

* New patches: Emoji style, Hide the Threads button (#50) and See who a story mentions.
* Every build of Instagram 450.0.0.50.77 patches now, not only 385611438 (#77, #95).
* New switches: Download video covers, Hide Meta AI in the share sheet, double tap to like On messages, Copy username and bio, View profile picture, Hide videos, photos and carousels on Home, and Import flag names in developer options.
* With View stories anonymously on, a story you watch keeps its colored ring (#92).
* Fixes for Show if a profile follows you (#40), the Welcome to Instagram card on Home (#28), carousels in Reels (#78), reel covers (#79) and HDR brightness on Android 14 and newer (#85).

## Instagram

* HushGram 0.0.7 adds 3 patches, for 78 in all, and stays on Instagram 450.0.0.50.77 with Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Besides build 385611438, the other arm64 builds of that version (385611395, 385611400, 385611404 and 385611431) and the x86 and x86_64 ones (385611439 and 385611440) patch now too.
* Show if a profile follows you now goes by what the profile screen itself heard, the same answer Instagram's own menu on that profile uses to offer Remove follower. On a few profiles the label said Doesn't follow you while that menu offered Remove follower, because the label read an older follow status Instagram had saved for the account. The saved status only counts now when the screen has no answer yet, and the chip under the counts goes by the same answer. Reported in #40.
* Open developer options adds Import flag names under Developer. Pick a name list, such as a file in Instagram's own id_name_mapping.json format or a text file of `config=name` lines, and Instagram's MetaConfig editor shows those names in its list and its search in place of numbers like _23355. Searching by a config's number still works. The names stay in HushGram's private folder and only change the editor's labels, so Instagram's schema and overrides keep the numbers, and so does an override export. Remove flag names puts the numbers back. HushGram doesn't ship a name list. Asked for in #50, #67 and #91.
* With View stories anonymously on, a story you watch keeps its colored ring and stays where it was in the tray. Before, the view was held back but Instagram still noted on the phone that you'd seen it, so the ring went gray and moved to the end of the row, which looked as if the view had gone out. A story you mark as seen still grays once its mark goes out. Reported in #92.
* The other arm64 builds of 450.0.0.50.77, 385611395, 385611400, 385611404 and 385611431, patch the way 385611438 does. Each build is compiled on its own, and Instagram's compiler moves a different set of strings into shared tables in each one and puts some code in other classes, so on 385611395 six patches and the story links part of Sanitize sharing links couldn't find what they change, and on 385611400 the HushGram row couldn't find the Settings screen. They read those tables now and look where the code moved, so they find the same places on all five builds. Morphe Manager still calls the four an unsupported version, since it can only be told one build number for each kind of phone. Reported in #77. The x86 and x86_64 builds, 385611439 and 385611440, patch that way too. The same change lets the HushGram row find their Settings screen. Read messages without the seen receipt no longer needs a helper 385611440 doesn't have, and on 385611439 Sanitize sharing links finds the copy link parser and Turn off double tap to like finds all three comment rows. Start on x86 devices now lets those two builds run their code protection step, since their code is x86 and nothing gets translated. Reported in #95.
* Download any video has a new switch under Downloads, Download video covers, that starts off. With it on, the menu of a feed post with a video, or of a carousel on a video page, gets Download cover. It saves the still picture you see before the video plays, at the largest size Instagram lists, the way Download cover on a reel does. Asked for in #94.
* Hide Meta AI has a new switch, Hide Meta AI in the share sheet, that starts off. Turn it on and Meta AI's target, which some accounts see as Muse, is gone from the row at the bottom of the share sheet. The other targets stay where they were.
* Turn off double tap to like has an On messages switch under it, off to start. With it on, a double tap on a message in a chat doesn't send a reaction. A long press still shows the reactions, and you can pick one there.
* Copy comment can also copy the username of whoever wrote a comment. Turn on Copy the commenter's username under Comments, then open a comment's menu and pick Copy username. It starts off and copies the name exactly. Asked for in #35.
* Settings entry has a new switch, Hide the HushGram row in Instagram's menu, for people who open HushGram from a tab long press and don't want the extra row at the top of Instagram's Settings and activity. It starts off. The row only goes while the tab you picked can open HushGram, so turning the long press off, or pausing HushGram, brings it back and there's always a way in. Asked for in #84.
* With Hide suggested posts on, Home could open on Instagram's Welcome to Instagram card for a few seconds, the one it shows when you follow nobody, before your posts loaded. A suggestion taken out anywhere in the app, or from what Home saved last time, was enough to make Home look finished while it was still waiting for its first page. Now only suggestions taken out of Home's own posts can end it, so it shows its usual loading placeholder until your posts arrive. Reported in #28.
* Open settings with a tab long press works as soon as you pick a tab. Before, the choice saved but only reached the tabs after Instagram restarted, so until then the tab's long press still did what it always had, which looked like the choice hadn't stuck. Profile could also go on opening Instagram's account switcher, even after a restart, because Instagram puts that long press on the Profile button a second way. That one follows your choice now too. Reported in #82.
* Download cover no longer fails with Download failed on a reel whose cover address has its size written into it, which the photo save mistook for a thumbnail. It saves the largest size the reel lists for its cover. Reported in #79, and thanks to @talhaeenss for finding the cause in #81.
* Download any reel saves every page of a carousel that turns up in Reels, in order. Before, it saved the first page whichever one you were looking at. Download as photo on a carousel with music saves them all too. Reported in #78.
* On Android 14 and newer, Turn off HDR brightness boosts also holds back the extra brightness Instagram asks for when it draws a video on a layer of its own. That layer shows the video brighter than the rest of the screen, and the switch didn't reach it before (#85).
* New patch, Hide the Threads button. Turn on its switch under Profiles and the Threads button at the top of a profile, yours or anyone else's, isn't built at all, so there's no gap where it was. The menu and the other buttons stay put. It's in the default selection with its switch off. Asked for in #50.
* New patch, Emoji style. Instagram already loads Google's emoji font through Google Play services, but it only uses it for emoji your phone's own font is missing. Turn on Google's emoji everywhere under Layout and every emoji Instagram runs through Android's emoji support draws in Google's style instead. It's in the default selection with its switch off, and a change shows fully after Instagram restarts.
* New opt-in patch, See who a story mentions. A story that mentions someone gets a pill under the name in its header, like 2 mentions, even when the mention sticker is hidden or off screen. Tap it to see who's mentioned, with their picture, name and username, and tap someone to open their profile. Its switch is under Stories. Asked for in #13 and #44.
* Hide suggested posts gets Hide videos, Hide photos and Hide carousels under Feed, and they start off. Each takes every post of its type out of Home, from accounts you follow too, and leaves profiles, Explore and Reels as they were. Reels count as videos.
* Save profile picture has a third switch under Downloads, Copy username and bio, that starts off. With it on, the menu on someone's profile also gets Copy username and Copy bio, which copy the account's username or bio exactly as it's written, emoji and line breaks included. An account with no bio gets no Copy bio. Asked for in #29.
* With Name saves by account and post time on, a saved profile picture is named for the account and the time you saved it, like `username_profile_20261007_105151.jpg`, instead of IG_IMG_. Off, it keeps the IG_IMG_ name.
* Hide the comment bar on reposted reels now keeps the bar hidden after Instagram tucks it away for a moment and brings it back, which some reposted reels do and which used to put the bar back under them. Asked for in #64.
* Save profile picture has a second switch under Downloads, View profile picture, that starts off. With it on, the menu on someone's profile also gets View profile picture, which opens their picture full screen at the largest size Instagram has, with pinch zoom and a Save button. Back closes it.

## Install or update

* Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer is still all you need.
* Update the HushGram source in Morphe Manager, or add it with the link in the README.
* Instagram 450.0.0.50.77 is still the target. Build 385611438, the (480-640dpi) bundle on APKMirror, is the one every check runs on. The other arm64 builds (385611395, 385611400, 385611404, 385611431) and the x86 and x86_64 ones (385611439, 385611440) patch too now, but Manager still names only 385611438, so it shows the others as unsupported. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not an Instagram APK.
* Keep the manager's signing key for updates, so the new build installs over the old one and you stay signed in.
* Read Before you sign in in the README first. A spare account keeps your main one out of it.

## Validation

2869 runtime tests and all 1182 patch tests passed locally. All 78 patches applied to Instagram 450.0.0.50.77 build 385611438 without forcing, and the resource and injected-code checks passed. The receipt and SHA256SUMS.txt beside the bundle list every file's hash.

YouTube
==
- chore(YouTube): Match some Extension with ReVanced
- feat(YouTube): Support version `19.44.39`
- feat(YouTube - Navigation bar components): Add `Disable translucent status bar` setting
- feat(YouTube - Navigation bar components): Separate `Enable translucent navigation bar` setting into `Disable light translucent bar` and `Disable dark translucent bar` settings
- feat(YouTube - Shorts components): Add `Restore old player layout` setting (YouTube 18.29.38 ~ 19.16.39)
- feat(YouTube - Shorts components): Add styles to custom actions dialog https://github.com/inotia00/revanced-patches/pull/107
- feat(YouTube - Spoof streaming data): Separate `Sync video length before playback` setting
- feat(YouTube - Swipe controls): Change the setting name `Enable watch panel gestures` to `Disable watch panel gestures`, and change the setting name `Enable swipe to change video` to `Disable swipe to change video`
- fix(YouTube - Custom Shorts action buttons): Patch not working on YouTube 19.38.41+
- fix(YouTube - Custom branding icon): Patch option `restoreOldSplashAnimation` not working in YouTube 19.32.39+
- fix(YouTube - Hide feed components): `Hide carousel shelf` hiding in library in certain situations
- fix(YouTube - Miniplayer): Use estimated maximum on screen size for devices with low density screens
- fix(YouTube - Theme): Splash background color not applied in latest YouTube client
- fix(YouTube - Video playback): Applying default video quality to Shorts causes the beginning of the shorts to get stuck in a loop
- fix(YouTube): Splash screen background color does not change in dark mode if `Theme` patch is excluded
- fix(YouTube): When clicking on timestamps in comments, playback speed sometimes changes to 1.0x (unpatched YouTube bug)


YouTube Music
==
- feat(YouTube Music - Hide action bar components): Limit the available versions of the `Override Download action button` setting to 7.16.53
- feat(YouTube Music - Spoof client): Add `Use old client` setting and `Default client` setting
- fix(YouTube Music - Hide action bar components): `Hide Download button` setting not working in YouTube Music 7.25.52
- fix(YouTube Music - SponsorBlock): `Change segment behavior` and `About` sections are hidden in the settings https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/2575
- fix(YouTube Music - Spoof client): Incorrect client version used
- fix(YouTube Music): Incorrect compatibility version specified for `Disable Cairo splash animation` patch


Reddit
==
- feat(Reddit): Remove version constraint
- fix(Reddit): Limit the available versions of the `Hide navigation buttons` patch to 2024.17.0


Shared
==
- chore(GmsCore support): Use more generic message
- chore(JsonPatchesFileGenerator): Match patch list format with ReVanced API 4
- chore(Spoof streaming data): Reduce the size of `approxDurationMsMap` and change it to remove it from the Map immediately
- feat(Spoof streaming data): Separate `Sync video length before playback` setting
- fix(Change version code): Remove patch option `changeVersionCode`, which is no longer needed
- fix(SponsorBlock): Show create new segment error messages using a dialog
- fix(Spoof streaming data): Performance degradation on iOS client https://github.com/inotia00/revanced-patches/pull/110
- refactor(Spoof streaming data): Instead of replacing the entire array `StreamingData.formats`, replace only the `approxDurationMs` field


Announcement
==
- YouTube Music's support version has been upgraded to **7.25.52**, but please read the following issue and upgrade only if necessary: https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/2554.
- Compatible ReVanced Manager: [RVX Manager v1.23.5 (fork)](https://github.com/inotia00/revanced-manager/releases/tag/v1.23.5).


Contribute to translation
==

- [YT Music](https://crowdin.com/project/revancedmusicextended)

## Morphe port — v1.0.0

This is the **first release of the Morphe port** of [pepper-revanced-patches](https://github.com/PawiX25/pepper-revanced-patches). The patch set and prebuilt APK variants mirror the upstream ReVanced **v1.4.0** release one-for-one — same fingerprints, same smali stubs, same telemetry coverage — but compiled against [Morphe Patcher 1.5.0](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patcher/releases/tag/v1.5.0) for the [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) ecosystem.

If you came here looking for the ReVanced equivalent, it lives at [PawiX25/pepper-revanced-patches](https://github.com/PawiX25/pepper-revanced-patches).

---

### Visual diff

**Pixel 10a (420 dpi):**
![Pixel 10a — before / after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PawiX25/pepper-morphe-patches/screenshots/screenshots/phone-comparison.png?v=2)

**Pixel 9 Pro XL (480 dpi):**
![Pixel 9 Pro XL — before / after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PawiX25/pepper-morphe-patches/screenshots/screenshots/emu-comparison.png?v=2)

Same `Najgorętsze` tab on both devices. **Left of each pair:** the standard
Pepper 8.13.00 deal-list (3 deals fit per screen). **Right of each pair:**
`Compact deal cards` enabled (4+ deals fit, thumbnails 92 dp, vote buttons
32 dp, denser title/price stack, skeleton placeholder bars sized to match
the real button's visible area).

This release adds patch **#7 Compact deal cards** and reorganises the prebuilt
APKs around a 2×2 matrix (debug menu × compact cards), so you can pick the
exact combination you want without flipping toggles in Morphe Manager.

### What's new

#### Patch #7 — Compact deal cards (opt-in)
Resource-only patch that shrinks the redesigned 8.x deal-list cards and their
loading skeletons toward the denser pre-redesign density. Targeted XML edits
to `item_deal_thread_card.xml`, `item_deal_voucher_placeholder_card.xml` and
`item_sponsored_thread_placeholder_card.xml`.

Per-element changes (real card):

| Element | Original | After patch | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| `thread_image` | 108×108dp, marginTop=8 | **92×92dp**, marginTop=4, marginBottom=8 | smaller thumbnail with a guaranteed 8 dp gap above the comment row |
| `deal_thread_button_vote_*` | 36×36dp | **32×32dp** | thinner up/down vote pills |
| `deal_thread_text_temperature` | `Subtitle2` + minHeight 36 + body2 autosize | **`CaptionBold`** + minHeight 32 + caption autosize | 2-3 digit temperature fits the new 92 dp temperature box |
| `top_barrier barrierMargin` | 8 dp | **4 dp** | tighter gap below the optional sponsored header |
| `thread_text_title` | maxLines=4, marginTop=8, vertical_bias=0.5 | **maxLines=2**, marginTop=4, vertical_bias=0.25 | title clamps to 2 lines and hugs the top of its space |
| `thread_text_username marginBottom` | 8 dp | **4 dp** | less padding above the get-deal button |
| `thread_button_comment_count` | 48×48 dp, Start=parent | **32×32 dp**, Start=guideline_start | smaller comment button that respects the card's left guideline |
| `comment_count` | maxWidth=38, marginStart=38, Start=button | **maxWidth=42, gravity=center_vertical, height=32, Start_toEndOf=button** | comment count number renders **next to** the button instead of overlapping it via the original `marginStart=38dp` hack |
| `deal_thread_button_get_deal*` (×3) | wrap_content + Material default insets | **minHeight=40dp + insetTop=0 + insetBottom=0** + Baseline_toBaselineOf removed | the Material3 Button.Icon style ships with `insetTop=6dp`/`insetBottom=6dp` defaults — on a 40 dp View that leaves only 28 dp of orange button area, which clipped the Subtitle2 text. Zeroing the insets restores the full 40 dp visible area. |

Skeleton (`item_deal_voucher_placeholder_card.xml` and `item_sponsored_thread_placeholder_card.xml`):
- `placeholder_temperature_box` 108×36 → **92×32**
- `placeholder_image` 108×108 → **92×92**
- `placeholder_text_title` height 52 → **24** (single bar instead of two-line block)
- `placeholder_date / merchant / username` width 104 → **80**
- `placeholder_button_get_deal` height stays at 40 but margins drop 8 → **4**
- `placeholder_comment_and_share` 64×24 → **48×32** (matches the real comment button's 32 dp height)
- sponsored-only: `thread_header_text minHeight` 32 → **24** (smaller "SPONSORED" header bar)

All placeholder dimensions now match the real card 1:1, so the loading skeleton
snaps to the final layout instead of jumping when data arrives.

The patch is **opt-in** (`default = false`) — it only runs when you tick it in
Morphe Manager, or pass `-e "Compact deal cards"` to the CLI.

### Prebuilt XAPK variants
The Morphe Manager / morphe-cli workflow obviously still works for everyone — but
because debug-menu and compact-cards are both opt-in, there are four
sensible factory combinations and we ship one APK for each:

| File | Debug menu | Compact cards |
|---|---|---|
| `pepperpl-8.13.00.xapk` | ✗ | ✗ |
| `pepperpl-8.13.00-debug.xapk` | ✓ | ✗ |
| `pepperpl-8.13.00-compact.xapk` | ✗ | ✓ |
| `pepperpl-8.13.00-debug-compact.xapk` | ✓ | ✓ |

Every variant has the full telemetry-blocking family (T1–T10) and every other
default-on patch from v1.3.0 baked in.

### Patches in the bundle (unchanged from v1.3.0 unless noted)

| #   | Patch | Default | Effect |
|-----|---|---|---|
| 1   | Enable debug menu | **opt-in** | Re-enables the hidden 3-dot debug menu (45 dev actions). |
| 2   | Unlock tier-locked icons | on | All 12 membership-tier icons available in the picker. |
| 3   | Hide banner ads in feed | on | Pubmatic / DFPBanner ads never load; empty cell collapsed. |
| 4   | Always show event-theming icons | on | All 4 event icons available regardless of the active event. |
| 5   | Keep event icon after restart | on | Chosen event icon stays after the event ends. |
| 6   | Fix spacing around hidden ad cells | on | Companion to patch #3. |
| **7** | **Compact deal cards** | **opt-in** | **NEW.** See above. |
| T1  | Redirect tracker URLs to localhost | on | dex string-pool rewrite. |
| T2  | Neuter tracker auto-init ContentProviders | on | Vungle, Adjust, FB AN. |
| T3  | Kill Pepper first-party pixel tracking | on | NOP pixel worker + mock hwid (MD5-hex format). |
| T4  | Kill Datatransport upload pipeline | on | Crashlytics + Firebase logging. |
| T5  | Disable Google Mobile Ads SDK init | on | NOP `MobileAds.initialize`. |
| T6  | Disable GMA ad-load entry points | on | NOP every `loadAd*` on AdLoader / AdManager / RewardedAd. |
| T7  | Disable Adjust SDK | on | NOP every state-mutating `Adjust.*` static method. |
| T8  | Disable PAIRIP license check | on (com.pepperdeals only) | Sideloaded US build can open. |
| T9  | Skip Usercentrics consent screen | on | CMP screen + fetch wait → straight to notif prompt. |
| T10 | Block Pepper analytics-event-report tracker | on | Retrofit `@POST` rewrite to `http://127.0.0.1:1`. |

### Files
- `pepper-patches.mpp` / `pepper-morphe-patches-1.0.0.mpp` — patch bundle for Morphe Manager / morphe-cli
- `pepperpl-8.13.00.xapk` — vanilla telemetry-blocked Pepper PL
- `pepperpl-8.13.00-debug.xapk` — + debug menu
- `pepperpl-8.13.00-compact.xapk` — + compact cards
- `pepperpl-8.13.00-debug-compact.xapk` — + debug menu **and** compact cards
- `manifest.json` — used by Morphe Manager's source URL

Install the XAPK with SAI / APKMirror Installer / Morphe Manager.

### Compatible with
All 10 sister apps from the family (Pepper PL, NL, DE, UK, FR, MX, ES, AT, SE
and the US `com.pepperdeals` build). T8 is restricted to `com.pepperdeals`
(only that build ships PAIRIP).
